name: VOICE
title: Voice control
description: Control the app by talking to it: say 'swing', 'fly', 'swim' or 'whirlpool' to change mode, 'soar' / 'sink' / 'soar faster' while flying, 'swing higher', 'change sway to north', 'increase wave height', 'start ride', and set any setting with 'set <setting> to <value>', 'increase <setting>' or '<setting> on'. Listens continuously (Web Speech API in the browser, Android's speech recognizer in the app) and shows what it heard. Optionally, a small AI model running on the device (WebGPU, never the cloud) interprets free phrasing through the app's own tools.
